digest.component_or_area: adapters/jira_family (new), adapters/jira, adapters/jira_datacenter; reconciler config schema
propositions: Self-hosted Jira Data Center instances differ from Cloud on three axes: REST v2 vs v3 API, wiki/plain-text vs ADF bodies, PAT bearer auth vs ACLI subprocess, name-based vs accountId user identity
PR #120's proposed second adapter duplicated field mapping logic and reached into private modules without a defined contract, creating a de facto shared layer without structural enforcement

Jira Cloud and DC must share single-sourced field/status/priority maps and sanitizers via a jira_family sub-seam, with contracts for rich-text codec and user identity allowing per-deployment implementations
DC transport built on pycontribs/jira library gated behind [jira-datacenter] optional extra, with lazy import to keep engine dependencies unchanged

TLS requirement for DC base_url with allow_insecure override and never-disabled certificate verification; PAT read from JIRA_PAT env var only, never from config file; operator docs require service account with least-privilege project-scoped scope
